title: Beyond Polytopes: Damped Newton Frank--Wolfe Methods over Compact Convex Sets
summary: We study convex optimization over compact convex sets for twice differentiable objective functions with positive definite Hessians, assuming access to the feasible set through a linear minimization oracle. Existing second-order Frank--Wolfe methods either provide only a local linear rate over general convex sets or achieve global linear and local quadratic convergence only over polytopes. We propose damped Newton Frank--Wolfe methods that approximately solve constrained damped Newton subproblems using Frank--Wolfe or away-step Frank--Wolfe inner iterations.
